title: Patch: a Spell's effects on every card and its random picks pass a Unit Immune to Spells by, as its aimed ones already do, and Meteor's spill skips a Dormant neighbour
notes: R4453000: a Spell's effects pass a field Unit Immune to Spells by however its text reaches it (§6.1): a card scope's field walk (card_scope::cards_in_card_scope marks the card unmatched, so R440's whole-pile cues stay whole), buff_all_units, switch_all_positions, the Radiant picks' field pool (set_radiant_random, radiant_chance) and a Plague Counter placement; a copy in a hand or a deck is still reached, and Units, Field Spells and Traps still reach it. S #3 Meteor's spill (R1848001) passes a Dormant neighbour by and goes on to the other neighbour and, on the Radiant face, the hero. classify stage 2 against main's build (8f32230a36) finds 66 cards that play differently, all through the engine's unforced games, and no rule every game meets; they are claimed with --plays. No KEPT_SCRIPTS entry: the verbs change for every catalog. Replays this change alters are refused as rules_changed (R767000).

player.title: Spells pass Immune to Spells Units by
changes: Every Spell now passes a Unit with Immune to Spells on the field by, not only one that aims at it: Spells that change every Unit or pick cards at random leave it as it is.
Your own immune Unit misses your helpful Spells too.
Adaptive Growth's -2/-2, Leg Day's Buff and Friend of Felinors' Radiant +2/+2 skip an immune Unit.
5pek Controller leaves an immune Unit in its position.
高考's Buff now spares an immune card, as its destroy already did.
Z-Patch's and B-Patch's Buffs and Nerfs, Appropriations' Military, Healthcare and Culture, Anti-Softlock and Transcend skip an immune Unit on the field. Copies in a hand or a deck are still changed.
Knockoff Temu Glowy Jelly Bean never makes an immune Unit on the field Radiant.
fixes: Meteor's leftover damage stopped at a Dormant card beside its target. It now goes on to the Unit on the other side and, on the Radiant face, to the enemy hero.
Book of Plague's Plague Counters placed at random could land on a Unit with Immune to Spells. They never do now.
